title: One command layer on the typed action registry: Cmd/Ctrl+K palette and quick switcher, platform slash commands, shortcut sheet, then a unified 'To:' picker

Grep 'shortcut sheet|ShortcutSheet|keyboard shortcuts|kbd' in verevonv3/src (only a static cmd-K kbd hint in knowledge search)
Grep 'metaKey|ctrlKey' in verevonv3/src (CoreNavbar Cmd/Ctrl+K opens search; chat shortcuts module)

matchDraftCommand resolves a leading slash command against the catalogue.

Per-button wrapper: preview then execute; not a palette or switcher.
'To:' label in the inbox reply only; no unified people picker.

Audit: CTRL+K overlay lacks focus trap and arrow or Enter result keys.
